objects.name: emdash_media_usage_fence_source_generation_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER emdash_media_usage_fence_source_generation_insert
		BEFORE INSERT ON _cms_media_usage_sources
		WHEN EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM _cms_media_usage_cleanup_fence AS fence
			WHERE fence.task_key = 'projection_gc'
				AND NEW.current_generation <= fence.generation_floor
		) AND NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM _cms_media_usage_generation_writes AS writer
			WHERE writer.source_key = NEW.source_key
				AND writer.generation = NEW.current_generation
				AND writer.expires_at > strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
		)
		BEGIN
			SELECT RAISE(IGNORE);
		END

objects.name: emdash_media_usage_fence_source_generation_update
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER emdash_media_usage_fence_source_generation_update
		BEFORE UPDATE OF current_generation ON _cms_media_usage_sources
		WHEN NEW.current_generation <> OLD.current_generation
			AND EXISTS (
				SELECT 1
				FROM _cms_media_usage_cleanup_fence AS fence
				WHERE fence.task_key = 'projection_gc'
					AND NEW.current_generation <= fence.generation_floor
			) AND NOT EXISTS (
				SELECT 1
				FROM _cms_media_usage_generation_writes AS writer
				WHERE writer.source_key = NEW.source_key
					AND writer.generation = NEW.current_generation
					AND writer.expires_at > strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
			)
		BEGIN
			SELECT RAISE(IGNORE);
		END

objects.name: emdash_media_usage_record_cleanup_fence
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER emdash_media_usage_record_cleanup_fence
		BEFORE DELETE ON _cms_media_usage
		WHEN OLD.cleanup_lease_token IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM _cms_media_usage_cleanup AS cleanup
			WHERE cleanup.task_key = 'projection_gc'
				AND cleanup.lease_token = OLD.cleanup_lease_token
		)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO _cms_media_usage_cleanup_fence (
				task_key,
				generation_floor,
				updated_at
			)
			VALUES ('projection_gc', OLD.generation, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))
			ON CONFLICT (task_key) DO UPDATE SET
				generation_floor = CASE
					WHEN excluded.generation_floor > _cms_media_usage_cleanup_fence.generation_floor
					THEN excluded.generation_floor
					ELSE _cms_media_usage_cleanup_fence.generation_floor
				END,
				updated_at = excluded.updated_at;
		END
